summary: Superseding TOOL-REXP claim (D2d-2): adds curated-first exact reference resolution and manifest provenance cross-check refusal to scripts/automation/result_explorer.py, on top of the D2c implementation. New behavior: a named reference_evidence_query now resolves FIRST against an optional sources['reference_evidence_yaml'] curated registry (automation/registry/reference_evidence.yaml in production, untouched by this claim); an exact-key hit returns exactly one row after cross-checking its provenance paths (explicit allowlist: confusion_csv, result_report, source_file) against the manifest -- every path must exist there and the manifest evidence_level must agree with the curated entry's declared evidence_level (and required_manifest_evidence_level, when present); duplicate keys refuse (duplicate_curated_key); any missing path or evidence-level disagreement refuses (provenance_mismatch) and returns zero metrics, never a fabricated or manifest-only row. If no curated source is configured, or the key isn't curated, resolution falls through UNCHANGED to the pre-existing (D2c) goals.yaml reference_evidence_queries + ledger-filter path -- proven by F15 and 3 additional fallback-focused tests, and by all 12 pre-existing F1-F11 tests continuing to pass unmodified against the unchanged base 'sources' fixture. Real-data read-only smoke queries against the committed repository (automation/registry/reference_evidence.yaml, automation/artifact_manifest.csv, results/defense_attempt_inventory/defense_attempt_results_long.csv) confirmed exactly one curated result each for H15_eps0015_frozen (TP/FN/FP/TN 41/4/60/395, Rfall 0.911111, FAR 0.131868, eps 0.015, evidence_level frozen-test, protocol_id H15-TEST-EPS0015-AFAC-20260705, clean_disclosure_companion present, manifest_cross_check: pass on both confusion_csv and result_report paths) and AFAC_eps0030_F20_posthoc (TP/FN/FP/TN 36/9/91/364, Rfall 0.8, FAR 0.2, eps 0.030, evidence_level test-post-hoc, method optionB_AFAC, manifest_cross_check: pass) -- no provenance mismatch, no fabricated ledger row, no --split command, no experiment/training/validation/export/threshold-selection script invoked. Test suite: scripts/automation/test_result_explorer.py extended with F12 (curated H15), F13/F13b/F13c (provenance mismatch: wrong evidence level, missing manifest path, no-fabrication proof), F14 (curated AFAC), F15 (fallback path unaffected) plus 6 extra focused tests (duplicate key, missing curated registry, missing curated file path, malformed entry, exact-key no-fuzzy-matching, ordinary queries unchanged) -- 24/24 pass total, all pre-existing F1-F11 unmodified and still passing. Regression checks: scripts/automation/test_approve.py and test_verify.py re-run, unaffected, both ALL PASS. automation/acceptance/result-explorer.yaml status marker updated (IMPLEMENTED_D2_PENDING_D2D2 -> IMPLEMENTED_D2D2_PENDING_D3); the curated-first rule, manifest cross-check rule, provenance_mismatch state, and F12-F15 descriptions were already accurate from D2d-1 and required no rewrite. No results/, ledger, manifest, or registry files (goals.yaml, datasets.yaml, reference_evidence.yaml) were modified. H15, AFAC, D8, G1, A1, optionB_AFAC and all other historical experiment names/paths/protocol IDs are unchanged.
